F3.evidence: Primary, muted and on-accent are tokens. Disabled and link are not separate roles. Nav links use offwhite on the dark bar.

F4.evidence: Border is gray-light-3. Focus on nav links measured a 2px orange outline. No strong border role.

F5.evidence: Accent default is orange. Nav hover fills gray-dark-2. Pressed is a forced pseudo-class and did not change the orange fill.

F9.evidence: Spacing is a 4px unit (--spacing 0.25rem) with derived steps through 56px.

F10.evidence: Radius steps xs through 3xl are declared. Buttons measure 6px, which is radius-md.

F11.evidence: Nav controls are 40px and the hero CTA is 48px. Icon sizes and a focus-ring offset are not a sizing scale. Focus width on nav links is 2px.

F12.evidence: No elevation scale. The plan card shadow was measured once and not tokenised as a level.

F13.evidence: raw/motion.json covers home, pricing and login. Reduced motion is partial: 165 of 574 moving elements stop, and pricing-card-glow-breathe keeps looping.

F14.evidence: Desktop 1440 and phone 390 are captured. Container widths are tokens. Grid columns and z-index layers are not a written scale.

C1.evidence: Button, link, text field, menu, card and dialog are captured. Text area, select, checkbox, radio, switch, tabs, tooltip, toast, table, avatar and badge are missing or only visible in a screenshot.

C2.evidence: Hover, focus-visible and pressed are captured on nav and hero buttons. Disabled, loading, selected and error were not shown.

C3.evidence: Nav links, Sign In, Start for Free and the hero CTA have a focus-visible crop. The nav link outline is 2px orange.

C4.evidence: components.md names a core colour token when the computed hex matches. Sizes stay in px.
